messages:
maria: hey @eng-ml — heads up: customer Acme is asking to run hf/saturnx-70b on Dedicated. Requirements: int8 quantized build, p95 latency <=200ms for 128-token prompts, and model quality within ~2% of float baseline on our instruction evals. They've also flagged apparent hallucination regressions when system prompts include policy text. Can we triage feasibility + risks? Link to customer notes: https://acme.internal/reqs/saturnx-70b

leo: got it. quick q — what's their input distribution? average and 95th seq len? batch sizes?

maria: thanks — typical is single-user requests, batch=1, avg len ~80, 95th ~220. peak qps expected ~8 rps to start, may scale to 20. They prefer single-model endpoint with fallback to 13B if capacity constrained.

sam: sounds doable but int8 for 70B can be tricky depending on attention ops and layernorm fusion. Plan I propose:
- smoke quant (q4_0, q8_0 if needed) on a dev shard
- run offline instruction evals + a small safety/regression suite (the customer-provided prompts + our eval set)
- run perf profiling (p95/p50, memory) with 128-token warmup and 1-2 KV cache reuse scenarios

Quick conversion snippet I usually start with:
```python
# minimal example
from quantize import quantize_model
quantize_model('hf/saturnx-70b', dtype='int8', method='q4_0', out='saturnx-70b-q4_0')
```
I can get a smoke build in ~48-72h if infra is available. Expect some quality delta; we'll compare eval metrics and do manual spot checks.

ayana: infra notes — Dedicated pool has empty 8x A10g nodes next week. Memory estimate after q4_0: ~40GB RAM + 24GB GPU per shard (rough). For p95 <=200ms with batch=1, we should aim for 2x shard replica with batching disabled and low-latency networking. Also need to reserve capacity for fallback model.

leo: for validation, let's run these: lm_instruct_eval (our instruction set), factuality_smoke (50 prompts from customer), and safety_regressions. Acceptance criteria: delta <=2% on macro-accuracy metrics, no new high-severity hallucinations in the factuality sample. If quant shows >2% drop, try q8_0 or per-channel calibration.

maria: customer timeline = wants canary within 2 weeks. Can we hit that?

sam: baseline timeline: smoke quant 2-3d, internal eval + perf 2-3d, canary rollout + monitoring 1-3d. So 6-9 business days optimistic. Main risks: regression on certain prompts (system-pinned policy text) and memory blowup if KV caching isn't trimmed. If we need q8_0 we'll add 1-2 days.

harper: I'll open the onboarding ticket and add the eval artifacts + customer prompts. Also can help shape canary dashboards (latency, cost-per-token, eval deltas).

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-4821: "saturnx-70b Dedicated onboarding — Acme" — assignees: sam, leo, ayana, harper. Priority: high.

maria: great — tagging @Acme success contact and syncing expectations. I'll share the customer prompts in INF-4821.

leo: I'll start with the conversion and baseline float run on a small shard. Sam — can you pair on calibration if q4_0 looks poor?

sam: yes, i'll join. also want to try per-layer outlier clipping if we see instability.

ayana: reserving 2 nodes in Dedicated pool for first week. If testing shows higher memory, I'll escalate to infra to get larger GPUs.

maria: perfect. thanks team :thumbsup:

harper: next steps summarized in ticket. tagging this for weekly sync if any blockers show up.

leo: assigning initial tasks and will post progress updates in the ticket thread.
thread_text: New model triage: customer Acme wants SaturnX-70B on Dedicated, int8, p95 <=200ms, quality within 2% of float; team discusses quant plan, infra, evals, timeline, creates INF-4821
